expectations.evidence: Uses its own structure (Overview, Strengths, Issues, Alignment Matrix, Summary) — does not use the 5-level maturity framework
Mentions B0/B1 phases but does not reference any specific git dates, commit hashes, or commit counts
Identifies all migrations 000001-000007 and references OpenAPI spec, though does not list commit dates
Uses Medium/Low/Informational severity on issues, not a maturity-level Pass/Partial/Fail framework
Each issue includes a Recommendation section with specific fixes
No git churn analysis — does not compare schema change frequency to code change frequency
Well-structured with headings, tables (overview, alignment matrix, summary assessment), clear sections
